name: sank
//imports: Node subpath imports, so `#shared/*` resolves outside Nuxt too — `npm run db:seed` runs seed.ts through tsx with no Vite and no Nitro alias in sight, and server code imports real values (not just types) from shared/.
//scripts: `db:seed` and `db:dev-pins` are the two scripts that hash PINs, and neither runs inside Nuxt — so neither gets Nuxt's automatic .env loading. Without `--env-file-if-exists=.env` they hash with no PIN_PEPPER and write a database no server can verify a PIN against. `--env-file-if-exists` rather than `--env-file` because a fresh clone has no .env yet, and the shell still wins: `DB_PATH=data/verify.db npm run db:seed` seeds data/verify.db even when .env names another file.
